intro: Find the Shattered Hand is a journey quest sending promising Forsaken rogues from Tirisfal Glades across the sea to Durotar. Directed by the Deathstalkers, the initiate travels to Orgrimmar's shadowy underbelly to learn specialized arts from the Shattered Hand clan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have served the Deathstalkers well, friend, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.
The Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? How uninspiring....
